onboarding.title.description: Main heading of the first screen, before this console is paired. “Tabsend” is the product name.

onboarding.what.message: Tabsend sends a web page from one of your devices to another, such as from your computer to your phone. The console is a web page that lists your devices and shows what you sent. It can't send tabs itself. Use the Tabsend browser extension or phone app for that.
onboarding.what.description: Paragraph under the main heading of the first screen. Explains what Tabsend and this “console” are for a first-time visitor.

onboarding.newHere.message: New to Tabsend? <link>Learn more at tabsend.org</link>.
onboarding.newHere.description: Short line under that paragraph. The part in <link>…</link> is a link to the Tabsend website and stays inside the link. “tabsend.org” is an address: keep it.

onboarding.pair.title.description: Heading of the box where the person pastes a setup link.

onboarding.pair.body.message: Open Tabsend on a device you already use, choose Add a device, and paste its setup link here.
onboarding.pair.body.description: Instruction in that box. “Add a device” is the exact button label in the apps and the browser extension: use the same words.

onboarding.setupLink.label.description: Label of the first text box, where the pairing link is pasted.

onboarding.setupLink.placeholder.description: Grey example inside the empty setup-link box. Shows the shape of a link, not a real address; keep the address shape.

onboarding.name.label.description: Label of the second text box, where the person names this browser in the group.

onboarding.name.placeholder.description: Grey hint inside the empty name box, with an example name in quotes.

onboarding.name.default.description: Name given to this console when the person leaves the name box empty; other devices show it in their lists. Short.

onboarding.name.deviceSeed.message: {platform, select, macos {Mac} windows {Windows PC} linux {Linux PC} android {Android} ios {iPhone} other {This device}}
onboarding.name.deviceSeed.description: Second part of the name suggested in the name box, chosen by the computer's system: the suggestion reads “Web console · Mac”. The person can change it. Mac, Windows, Linux, Android and iPhone are product names; translate only the word PC (if your language says it otherwise) and “This device”. Keep it short. Same words as the browser extension's setup page.

onboarding.name.withBrowser.description: Suggested name when the browser could name itself. {browser} is the browser's name, such as Firefox. Short.

onboarding.submit.description: Button under the two text boxes that pairs this console with the group.

onboarding.privacy.message: Tabsend encrypts what you send on your devices. The server holds no key to read it, and the console never opens tabs.
onboarding.privacy.description: Small print under the pairing button about privacy.
